content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: M.Sc. in Agriculture, Botany, Zoology, Biotechnology, or any other relevant discipline of Life Sciences from a recognised university/institute. Age limit: Maximum 35 years (as on 16 November 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/Women/differently abled Usual relaxation as per Government of India rules Other conditions: The position is purely contractual and co-terminus with the project. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview or joining. The Institute does not have residential facilities for contractual staff. Desirable: Previous research experience in plant nanobiotechnology, plant stress physiology, and/or plant-microbe or plant-soil interactions. Experience in conducting pot experiments, greenhouse experiments, and field trials.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Duration initially till 31 March 2027 from the date of joining, which may be extended or terminated earlier based on performance and fund availability.

content_sections.heading: How Will ISI Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written test in the subject area to shortlist candidates, if required Interview Written test in the subject area may be held to shortlist candidates for interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Date of birth Academic Qualifications (Bachelor's and Master's degree certificates and marksheets) Caste certificate Identity Proof issued by the Government of India / Government of West Bengal Disability certificate (if required) Experience Certificate Recent Passport Size Photograph

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: A resume with incomplete information or without supporting documents will be summarily rejected. Selected candidates have to produce all relevant documents in original and a medical certificate of fitness at the time of joining.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ISI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ISI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Associate-I.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ISI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (as on 16 November 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/Women/differently abled Usual relaxation as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs 31,000 or Rs 25,000 plus HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.Sc. in Agriculture, Botany, Zoology, Biotechnology, or any other relevant discipline of Life Sciences from a recognised university/institute.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. The position is purely contractual and co-terminus with the project. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview or joining. The Institute does not have residential facilities for contractual staff.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written test in the subject area to shortlist candidates, if required. Interview. Written test in the subject area may be held to shortlist candidates for interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Duration initially till 31 March 2027 from the date of joining, which may be extended or terminated earlier based on performance and fund availability.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Kolkata.
